responsibility: Generates `insn-attr-common.h`, the small shared header that records machine-description attribute enums and scheduling feature macros used by both the compiler proper and the build-time generators. It scans `define_attr`, `define_delay`, and `define_insn_reservation` entries to emit `enum attr_*` definitions, the `DELAY_SLOTS` flag, and the `INSN_SCHEDULING` macro that summarize target delay-slot and pipeline-hazard capabilities.
